name: Melao Whitening Serum 30ml
description:
Title: MELAO Skin Moisturizing Acid Essence Whitening Lightening Kojic Serum – 30ml
Brand: Melao
Country of Origin: China
Volume: 30 ml
Gender: Women
Usage Area: Face
Item Form: Liquid

Features

Dual-action formula focused on skin brightening

Contains Hyaluronic Acid for deep hydration

Enriched with Antioxidants to fight skin ageing & hyperpigmentation

Helps reduce dark spots, discoloration, and uneven skin tone

Product Benefits

Smoothens skin irregularities

Helps reduce sunburn & acne discoloration

Improves overall skin clarity & radiance

Skin Type

Suitable for all skin types

Scent

Unscented

Skin Care Advice

Avoid direct sun exposure while using

Always apply a broad-spectrum sunscreen (SPF 30+) to prevent hyperpigmentation from getting darker

Key Ingredient

Vitamin C
